chunks: And My curse is upon you until the Day of Recompense.

key_terms.لَعْنَتِى: My curse (divine displeasure and expulsion from mercy)
key_terms.يَوْمِ الدِّينِ: Day of Recompense/Judgment (the day when souls are repaid for their deeds)

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'My curse is upon you until the Day of Doom' signify in Surah Sad?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir, this verse is often interpreted as a specific curse upon Iblis for his arrogance, but also serves as a general principle for those who reject divine authority, with some scholars extending its application to the enemies of the Ahl al-Bayt. The phrase 'until the Day of Judgment' (ila yawm ad-din) highlights the enduring nature of this divine displeasure, contrasting with temporary worldly punishments. This underscores the concept of 'La'nah' not merely as a wish for punishment, but as a permanent state of being cut off from Allah's mercy due to persistent kufr.
